about: Numbers shown on the landing page (web/landing.html), written by energy2047 from the same results as the CSV files in this folder. Energy generated in TWh; fiscal years labelled by their start year.
holdout_range_note: Both years fall inside the model's 90% range.

drivers.label: Demand rises less as incomes rise
Urban share 5 points above UN path

base.description: India elasticity with the excess-urbanisation prior

no_urban_term.description: gamma = 0: no urbanisation effect beyond income (UN population path still used)

elasticity_decline_0_2.description: elasticity falls 0.2 per unit of ln income

urban_plus_5.description: urban share 5 points above the UN path by 2047

beta_minus_1se.description: income elasticity lower by one OLS standard error (0.065) in every replicate

beta_plus_1se.description: income elasticity higher by one OLS standard error (0.065) in every replicate

beta_window_s1.description: elasticity from the FY2011-12 onward window only (one price base)

beta_window_s3.description: elasticity from the FY2006-07 onward window only (spliced price bases)

beta_first_difference.description: elasticity recentred on the first-difference estimate (shift -0.068 in every replicate)

jk_excluded.description: Jammu and Kashmir left out of national income growth instead of deflating its current-price GSDP (2012 onward) with the MoSPI GDP deflator; elasticity re-estimated: S1 beta 0.835, S3 beta 0.871

growth_decomposition.note: Shares of the log growth of the central path (medium drivers, mean income growth), not of the median; model error is the fading of the high base-year residual.

state_panel.note: Diagnostic only, never used: ln(NPP state generation per person) on ln(GSDP per person) with state fixed effects. NPP records generation where the plant stands (conventional stations only), so a state's figure measures where plants are, not its demand.

features.note: Outside the headline: the core forecast plus a signed adjustment in TWh for FY2047-48, ramped linearly from the base year and split across the regions by their share of the requirement. Official sources (secondary). T&D losses are an upper bound that may already be inside the trend: 0 at central.

list.name: Core (headline)
list.description: The two-dataset forecast with no feature layer: the headline.

list.name: Features central
list.description: Every quantified feature at its central value; T&D losses, an upper bound that may already be inside the trend, at 0.

list.name: Electrification high
list.description: Transport, green hydrogen, data centres and space cooling at their high values; the rest at central.

list.name: Efficiency and distributed
list.description: Every feature that lowers generation at its high value (T&D losses included, at their upper bound); the rest at central.

list.name: Climate stress
list.description: Space cooling and storage round-trip losses at their high values; the rest at central.

list.name: All upside
list.description: Every feature that raises generation at its high value and every one that lowers it at its low value (T&D losses at 0).

list.name: All downside
list.description: Every feature that raises generation at its low value and every one that lowers it at its high value (T&D losses at their upper bound).

core.name: Core (headline)
core.description: The two-dataset forecast with no feature layer: the headline.

features_central.name: Features central
features_central.description: Every quantified feature at its central value; T&D losses, an upper bound that may already be inside the trend, at 0.

electrification_high.name: Electrification high
electrification_high.description: Transport, green hydrogen, data centres and space cooling at their high values; the rest at central.

efficiency_distributed.name: Efficiency and distributed
efficiency_distributed.description: Every feature that lowers generation at its high value (T&D losses included, at their upper bound); the rest at central.

climate_stress.name: Climate stress
climate_stress.description: Space cooling and storage round-trip losses at their high values; the rest at central.

all_upside.name: All upside
all_upside.description: Every feature that raises generation at its high value and every one that lowers it at its low value (T&D losses at 0).

all_downside.name: All downside
all_downside.description: Every feature that raises generation at its low value and every one that lowers it at its high value (T&D losses at their upper bound).

joint.description: Core draws plus independent feature draws: each feature triangular (low, central, high) times its sign; T&D losses uniform from 0 to their upper bound.

p90_plan.note: Least-cost Robust plan planned for the core + features joint P90 (and P50), against the core P90. Unmet is requirement the plan cannot serve; null = infeasible.

cost_basis_cea.description: CEA NEP 2022-32 cost basis in real 2024 USD (CERC WACC made real at the RBI target, 4%; CEA and CERC fuel; MoSPI GDP deflator; RBI 2024 rate); nuclear and gas at IEA

cost_basis_cea_pi2.description: the same CEA cost basis with the CERC WACC made real at 2% inflation (RBI lower tolerance)

cost_basis_cea_pi6.description: the same CEA cost basis with the CERC WACC made real at 6% inflation (RBI upper tolerance)

solar_potential_nise2014.description: solar potential: NISE 2014 technical potential instead of NISE 2025 ground-mounted

wind_120m.description: onshore wind potential: NIWE 120 m instead of 150 m

nominal_outlook.label: Information only: nominal money of 2047. The headline cost is real 2024 USD.
nominal_outlook.method: INR: real 2024 USD x Rs per USD (RBI calendar-2024 average) x (1 + RBI CPI target)^(year - 2024); USD: real 2024 USD x (1 + FOMC longer-run goal, PCE price index)^(year - 2024). 1 lakh crore = 10^12 rupees. Sources: data/external/macro/price_indices.csv (secondary).

mix.label: Firmed renewables
mix.note: solar and wind backed by storage, sold round the clock

vectors_other.label: Firmed renewables and bioenergy
vectors_other.note: Not among the six sources: solar and wind sold round the clock with storage, and bioenergy. With them the six shares add up to 100% of the plan.
